40022274.author: पदार्थः
40022274.content: तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, भाषितं speech, तस्य his, शत्रुघ्नस्य of Shatrughna, महात्मनः the great-souled, क्रोधं anger, आहारयत् he felt, तीव्रं intense, तिष्ठ stop, तिष्ठ stop, इति thus, च and, अब्रवीत् he said

40022274.author: Translation
40022274.content: Having heard that speech of the great-souled Shatrughna, he felt intense anger and exclaimed, "Stop! Stop!"

40022275.author: पदार्थः
40022275.content: पाणौ in hand, पाणिं hand, विनिष्पिष्य having pressed, दन्तान् teeth, कटकटाय्य having gnashed, च and, लवणो Lavaṇa, रघुशार्दूलम् the tiger among Raghus (Shatrughna), आह्वयामास challenged, च and, असकृत् repeatedly.

40022275.author: Translation
40022275.content: Lavaṇa, pressing his hands together and gnashing his teeth, repeatedly challenged Shatrughna, the foremost of the Raghu dynasty.

40022276.author: पदार्थः
40022276.content: तं him, ब्रुवाणं speaking, तथा such, वाक्यं words, लवणं Lavaṇa, घोरदर्शनम् of terrible appearance, शत्रुघ्नो Shatrughna, देवशत्रुघ्न the destroyer of the gods' enemy, इदं this, वचनम् word, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40022276.author: Translation
40022276.content: To Lavaṇa, who was speaking such words and had a terrible appearance, Shatrughna, the destroyer of the gods' enemy, spoke these words.

40022277.author: पदार्थः
40022277.content: न not, शत्रुघ्नस्तथा Shatrughna is such, जातो born, यथा as, अन्ये others, निर्जितास्त्वया conquered by you, तदद्य therefore today, बाणाभिहतो struck by arrows, व्रज go, त्वं you, यमसादनम् to the abode of Yama.

40022277.author: Translation
40022277.content: Shatrughna declared that he was not like the others Lavaṇa had conquered, and therefore, Lavaṇa would today be struck by his arrows and go to the abode of Yama.

40022278.author: पदार्थः
40022278.content: ऋषयो sages, अप्यद्य also today, पापात्मन् O evil-souled one, मया by me, त्वां you, निहतं slain, रणे in battle, पश्यन्तु let them see, विप्रा Brahmins, विद्वांसः learned ones, त्रिदशाः gods, इव like, रावणम् Ravana.

40022278.author: Translation
40022278.content: Shatrughna wished that the sages, Brahmins, and learned ones, like the gods witnessing Ravana's fall, would today see him slay the evil-souled Lavaṇa in battle.

40022279.author: पदार्थः
40022279.content: त्वयि you, मद्बाणनिर्दग्धे burnt by my arrows, पतिते fallen, अद्य today, निशाचर O night-wanderer, पुरे in the city, जनपदे in the country, च and, अपि also, क्षेममेव welfare indeed, भविष्यति will be.

40022279.author: Translation
40022279.content: Shatrughna declared that with Lavaṇa, the night-wanderer, burnt by his arrows and fallen today, there would indeed be welfare in both the city and the country.

40022280.author: पदार्थः
40022280.content: अद्य today, मद्बाहुनिष्क्रान्तः issued from my arm, शरः arrow, वज्रनिभाननः having a thunderbolt-like tip, प्रवेक्ष्यते will enter, ते your, हृदयम् heart, पद्मम् a lotus, अंशुः a ray, इव like, अर्कजः of the sun,

40022280.author: Translation
40022280.content: Today, the arrow released from my arm, with its thunderbolt-like tip, will pierce your heart just as a sunbeam penetrates a lotus.

40022281.author: पदार्थः
40022281.content: एवम् thus, उक्तः addressed, महावृक्षम् a great tree, लवणः Lavana, क्रोधमूर्च्छितः overcome with anger, शत्रुघ्नोरसि on Shatrughna's chest, चिक्षेप threw, सः he, च and, तम् that, शतधा into a hundred pieces, अच्छिनत् cut,

40022281.author: Translation
40022281.content: Thus addressed, Lavana, overcome with rage, hurled a massive tree at Shatrughna's chest, but Shatrughna instantly shattered it into a hundred pieces.

40022282.author: पदार्थः
40022282.content: तत् that, दृष्ट्वा having seen, विफलम् fruitless, कर्म action, राक्षसः the demon, पुनरेव again indeed, तु and, पादपान् trees, सुबहून् very many, गृह्य seizing, शत्रुघ्नाय at Shatrughna, असृजत् hurled, बली the powerful one,

40022282.author: Translation
40022282.content: Seeing that action prove fruitless, the powerful demon Lavana again seized very many trees and hurled them at Shatrughna.

40022283.author: पदार्थः
40022283.content: शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, च and, अपि also, तेजस्वी powerful, वृक्षान् trees, आपततः falling, बहून् many, त्रिभिः with three, चतुर्भिः with four, एकैकम् each one, चिच्छेद cut, नतपर्वभिः with bent-jointed arrows,

40022283.author: Translation
40022283.content: And the powerful Shatrughna, with his bent-shafted arrows, cut down each of the many approaching trees with three or four arrows.

40022284.author: पदार्थः
40022284.content: ततः then, बाणमयम् a shower of arrows, वर्षम् rain, व्यसृजत् discharged, राक्षसोरसि on the demon's chest, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, वीर्यसम्पन्नः endowed with valor, विव्यथे was pained, न not, सः that, राक्षसः demon,

40022284.author: Translation
40022284.content: Then, the valorous Shatrughna unleashed a shower of arrows upon the demon's chest, but that demon was not pained by them.

40022285.author: पदार्थः
40022285.content: ततः then, प्रहस्य having laughed, लवणो Lavana, वृक्षम् a tree, उद्यम्य having lifted, वीर्यवान् the mighty one, शिरसि on the head, अभ्यहनत् struck, शूरम् the brave one, स्रस्ताङ्गः with limbs loosened, सः he, मुमोह fainted, वै indeed.

40022285.author: Translation
40022285.content: Then, the mighty Lavana laughed, lifted a tree, and struck the brave Shatrughna on the head, causing him to faint with his limbs loosened.

40022286.author: पदार्थः
40022286.content: तस्मिन् when that, निपतिते fell down, वीरे brave one, हाहाकारो a cry of distress, महान् great, अभूत् arose, ऋषीणाम् of the sages, देवसङ्घानाम् of the hosts of gods, गन्धर्वाप्सरसां of Gandharvas and Apsaras, तथा and also.

40022286.author: Translation
40022286.content: When that brave warrior fell, a great cry of distress arose from the sages, hosts of gods, Gandharvas, and Apsaras.

40022287.author: पदार्थः
40022287.content: तम् him, अवज्ञाय disregarding, तु but, हतम् killed, शत्रुघ्नम् Shatrughna, भुवि on the ground, पातितम् fallen, रक्षो the demon, लब्धान्तरमपि even though having found an opportunity, न not, विवेश entered, स्वमालयम् his own abode.

40022287.author: Translation
40022287.content: Disregarding Shatrughna, who had fallen to the ground as if killed, the demon, even though he had found an opportunity, did not enter his own abode.

40022288.author: पदार्थः
40022288.content: न not, अपि even, शूलम् the trident, प्रजग्राह took up, तम् him, दृष्ट्वा having seen, भुवि on the ground, पातितम् fallen, ततः then, हतः killed, इति thus, ज्ञात्वा having known, तान् those, भक्षान् food items, समुदावहत् carried away.

40022288.author: Translation
40022288.content: Even after seeing Shatrughna fallen on the ground, Lavana did not pick up his trident; instead, thinking him dead, he carried away his prey.

40022289.author: पदार्थः
40022289.content: मुहूर्तात् in a moment, लब्धसञ्ज्ञस्तु having regained consciousness, पुनः again, तस्थौ stood, धृतायुधः holding his weapon, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, वै indeed, पुरद्वारि at the city gate, ऋषिभिः by the sages, सम्प्रपूजितः well-worshipped.

40022289.author: Translation
40022289.content: In a moment, Shatrughna regained consciousness, and, holding his weapon, he stood again at the city gate, honored by the sages.

40022290.author: पदार्थः
40022290.content: ततः then, दिव्यम् divine, अमोघम् unfailing, तम् that, जग्राह he took, शरम् arrow, उत्तमम् excellent, ज्वलन्तम् blazing, तेजसा with splendor, घोरम् dreadful, पूरयन्तम् filling, दिशः directions, दश ten.

40022290.author: Translation
40022290.content: Then he took that excellent, divine, and unfailing arrow, which was blazing with dreadful splendor and filling all ten directions.

40022291.author: पदार्थः
40022291.content: वज्राननम् having a tip like a thunderbolt, वज्रवेगम् having the speed of a thunderbolt, मेरुमन्दरसन्निभम् resembling Mount Meru and Mandara, नतम् bent, पर्वसु at the joints, सर्वेषु all, संयुगेषु in battles, अपराजितम् unconquered.

40022291.author: Translation
40022291.content: The arrow had a thunderbolt-like tip and speed, resembled Mount Meru and Mandara, was perfectly bent at all its joints, and remained unconquered in all battles.

40022292.author: पदार्थः
40022292.content: असृक् blood, चन्दन sandalwood, दिग्धाङ्गम् smeared on its body, चारुपत्रम् having beautiful feathers, पतत्रिणम् winged, दानवेन्द्र of the lords of Danavas, अचलेन्द्राणाम् of the lords of mountains, असुराणाम् of Asuras, च and, दारणम् a splitter.

40022292.author: Translation
40022292.content: Its body was smeared with blood and sandalwood, it had beautiful feathers, and it was capable of splitting the lords of Danavas, the lords of mountains, and the Asuras.

40022293.author: पदार्थः
40022293.content: तम् that, दीप्तम् blazing, इव like, कालाग्निम् the fire of destruction, युगान्ते at the end of an age, समुपस्थिते having arrived, दृष्ट्वा having seen, सर्वाणि all, भूतानि beings, परित्रासम् great fear, उपागमन् they experienced.

40022293.author: Translation
40022293.content: Seeing that arrow blazing like the fire of destruction at the end of a cosmic age, all beings were struck with great terror.

40022294.author: पदार्थः
40022294.content: सदेवासुरगन्धर्वम् with gods, asuras, and gandharvas, मुनिभिः with sages, साप्सरोगणम् with groups of Apsaras, जगत् the world, हि indeed, सर्वम् all, अस्वस्थम् uneasy, पितामहम् to Brahma, उपस्थितम् approached.

40022294.author: Translation
40022294.content: Indeed, the entire world, including gods, asuras, gandharvas, sages, and groups of Apsaras, became uneasy and approached Brahma.

40022295.author: पदार्थः
40022295.content: उवाच said, देवदेवेशं to the lord of gods, वरदं the bestower of boons, प्रपितामहम् to the great-grandfather, देवानां of the gods, भयसंमोहो fear and bewilderment, लोकानां of the worlds, सङ्क्षयं destruction, प्रति regarding.

40022295.author: Translation
40022295.content: The gods addressed Brahma, the great-grandfather and bestower of boons, regarding the fear and bewilderment among the gods and the impending destruction of the worlds.

40022296.author: पदार्थः
40022296.content: न not, ईदृशं such, दृष्टपूर्वं seen before, च and, न not, श्रुतं heard, प्रपितामह O great-grandfather, देवानां of the gods, भयसम्मोहो fear and bewilderment, लोकानां of the worlds, सङ्क्षयं destruction, प्रति regarding.

40022296.author: Translation
40022296.content: They declared to Brahma that such fear and bewilderment among the gods, concerning the destruction of the worlds, had never been seen or heard of before.

40022297.author: पदार्थः
40022297.content: तेषां their, तत् that, वचनं speech, श्रुत्वा having heard, ब्रह्मा Brahma, लोकपितामहः the great-grandfather of the worlds, भयकारणम् the cause of fear, आचष्ट explained, लोकानाम् of the worlds, अभयङ्करः the dispeller of fear, उवाच said, मधुरां sweet, वाणीं words, शृणुध्वं listen, सर्वदेवताः O all gods.

40022297.author: Translation
40022297.content: Having heard their words, Brahma, the great-grandfather and dispeller of fear for the worlds, explained the cause of their fear and spoke sweet words, asking all the gods to listen.

40022298.author: पदार्थः
40022298.content: वधाय for the killing, लवणस्य of Lavana, आजौ in battle, शरः the arrow, शत्रुघ्नधारितः held by Shatrughna, तेजसा by the radiance, तस्य of that, सम्मूढाः bewildered, सर्वे all, स्मः we are, सुरसत्तमाः O best of gods.

40022298.author: Translation
40022298.content: Brahma revealed that the gods' bewilderment was caused by the immense radiance of the arrow held by Shatrughna, intended for the killing of Lavana in battle.

40022299.author: पदार्थः
40022299.content: एष this, पूर्वस्य of the ancient, देवस्य god, लोककर्तुः the creator of the worlds, सनातनः eternal, शरः arrow, तेजोमयः full of light, वत्सा O dear ones, येन by which, वै indeed, भयम् fear, आगतम् has come.

40022299.author: Translation
40022299.content: Brahma further explained that this radiant arrow, which caused their fear, is the eternal weapon of the ancient god, the creator of the worlds.

40022300.author: पदार्थः
40022300.content: एषः this, वै indeed, कैटभस्य of Kaitabha, अर्थे for the sake of, मधुनः of Madhu, च and, महाशरः great arrow, सृष्टः created, महात्मना by the great-souled one, तेन by him, वधार्थे for the purpose of killing, दैत्ययोः of the two demons, तयोः those two,

40022300.author: Translation
40022300.content: This great arrow was indeed created by that great-souled one for the purpose of killing those two demons, Kaitabha and Madhu.

40022301.author: पदार्थः
40022301.content: एकः only one, एव indeed, प्रजानाति knows, विष्णुः Vishnu, तेजोमयम् full of splendor, शरम् arrow, एषा this, एव indeed, तनुः body, पूर्वा ancient, विष्णोः of Vishnu, तस्य of that, महात्मनः great-souled one,

40022301.author: Translation
40022301.content: Only Vishnu truly knows this arrow, which is full of splendor, for this is indeed the ancient form of that great-souled Vishnu himself.

40022302.author: पदार्थः
40022302.content: इतः from here, गच्छत go, पश्यध्वम् see, वध्यमानम् being killed, महात्मना by the great-souled one, रामानुजेन by Rama's younger brother, वीरेण by the hero, लवणम् Lavana, राक्षसोत्तमम् the chief of Rakshasas,

40022302.author: Translation
40022302.content: Go from here and witness Lavana, the chief of Rakshasas, being killed by the great-souled hero, Rama's younger brother.

40022303.author: पदार्थः
40022303.content: तस्य his, ते that, देवदेवस्य of the God of gods, निशम्य having heard, वचनम् words, सुराः the gods, आजग्मुः came, यत्र where, युध्येते were fighting, शत्रुघ्नलवणौ Shatrughna and Lavana, उभौ both,

40022303.author: Translation
40022303.content: Having heard the words of that God of gods, the deities arrived at the place where both Shatrughna and Lavana were engaged in battle.

40022304.author: पदार्थः
40022304.content: तम् that, शरम् arrow, दिव्यसङ्काशम् divine-looking, शत्रुघ्नकरधारितम् held in Shatrughna's hand, ददृशुः saw, सर्वभूतानि all beings, युगान्ताग्निम् the fire of the end of an age, इव like, उत्थितम् risen,

40022304.author: Translation
40022304.content: All beings saw that divine-looking arrow, held in Shatrughna's hand, shining like the risen fire of the cosmic dissolution.

40022305.author: पदार्थः
40022305.content: अकाशम् the sky, आवृतम् covered, दृष्ट्वा having seen, देवैः by gods, हि indeed, रघुनन्दनः Shatrughna, सिंहनादम् a lion's roar, भृशम् loudly, कृत्वा having made, ददर्श he saw, लक्षणम् Lakshmana, पुनः again.

40022305.author: Translation
40022305.content: Indeed, having seen the sky covered by gods, Shatrughna, after letting out a loud lion's roar, saw Lakshmana again.

40022306.author: पदार्थः
40022306.content: आहूतः called, च and, पुनः again, तेन by him, शत्रुघ्नेन by Shatrughna, महात्मना the great-souled, लवणः Lavana, क्रोधसंयुक्तः filled with anger, युद्धाय for battle, समुपस्थितः stood ready.

40022306.author: Translation
40022306.content: And again, challenged by the great-souled Shatrughna, Lavana, filled with anger, appeared ready for battle.

40022307.author: पदार्थः
40022307.content: आकर्णात् up to the ear, सः he, विकृष्य having drawn, अथ then, तत् that, धनुः bow, धन्विनाम् among archers, वरः the best, तम् that, मुमोच he released, महाबाणम् great arrow, लवणस्य of Lavana, महोरसि on the great chest.

40022307.author: Translation
40022307.content: Then, the best among archers, Shatrughna, having drawn that bow up to his ear, released that great arrow onto Lavana's broad chest.

40022308.author: पदार्थः
40022308.content: उरः the chest, तस्य his, विदार्य having pierced, आशु quickly, प्रविवेश it entered, रसातलम् the netherworld.

40022308.author: Translation
40022308.content: Quickly piercing his chest, the arrow entered the netherworld.

40022309.author: पदार्थः
40022309.content: गत्वा having gone, रसातलम् to the netherworld, दिव्यः divine, शरः arrow, विबुधपूजितः worshipped by gods, पुनरेव again indeed, आगमत् it came, तूर्णम् quickly, इक्ष्वाकुकुलनन्दनम् to the delight of the Ikshvaku family.

40022309.author: Translation
40022309.content: Having gone to the netherworld, the divine arrow, worshipped by gods, quickly returned to Shatrughna, the delight of the Ikshvaku family.

40022310.author: पदार्थः
40022310.content: शत्रुघ्नशरनिर्भिन्नो pierced by Shatrughna's arrow, लवणः Lavana, सः that, निशाचरः demon, पपात fell, सहसा suddenly, भूमौ on the ground, वज्राहतः struck by a thunderbolt, इव like, अचलः a mountain.

40022310.author: Translation
40022310.content: That demon Lavana, pierced by Shatrughna's arrow, suddenly fell to the ground like a mountain struck by a thunderbolt.

40022311.author: पदार्थः
40022311.content: तत् that, च and, शूलम् trident, महत् great, तेन by him, हते having been killed, लवणराक्षसे Lavana the demon, पश्यताम् while watching, सर्वदेवानाम् of all the gods, रुद्रस्य of Rudra, वशम् to the control, अन्वगात् returned.

40022311.author: Translation
40022311.content: And that great trident, after the demon Lavana was killed by Shatrughna, returned to the control of Rudra while all the gods watched.

40022312.author: पदार्थः
40022312.content: एकेषुपातेन by the shot of a single arrow, भृशम् completely, निपात्य having struck down, लोकत्रयस्य of the three worlds, अपि even, रघुप्रवीरः the great hero of the Raghu dynasty, विनिर्बभौ shone forth, उत्तमचापबाणः with an excellent bow and arrow, तमः darkness, प्रणुद्य having dispelled, इव like, सहस्ररश्मिः the sun.

40022312.author: Translation
40022312.content: Having completely struck down the terror of the three worlds with a single arrow, the great hero of the Raghu dynasty, Shatrughna, shone forth with his excellent bow and arrow, just like the sun dispelling darkness.

40022313.author: पदार्थः
40022313.content: ततः then, हि indeed, देवाः gods, ऋषि sages, पन्नगाः serpents, च and, प्रपूजिरे worshipped, हि indeed, अप्सरसः Apsaras, च and, सर्वाः all, दिष्ट्या fortunately, जयः victory, दाशरथेः of Dasharatha's son, अवाप्तः obtained, त्यक्त्वा having abandoned, भयम् fear, सर्पः a serpent, इव like, प्रशान्तः calmed.

40022313.author: Translation
40022313.content: Then indeed, all the gods, sages, serpents, and Apsaras worshipped him, exclaiming that fortunately, victory had been obtained by Dasharatha's son, and they were now calm, having abandoned fear, like a pacified serpent. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे एकोनसप्ततितमः सर्गः ।। 69 ।। Thus ends the sixty-ninth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
